system.description: Armor Class: 5 Hit Dice: 4* (S) Move: 120' (40') Attacks: 1 bite Damage: ld6 No. Appearing: ld6(ld6 + 3) Save As: F4 Morale: 6 Treasure Type: C Intelligence: 9 Alignment: Lawful XP Value: 125 Monster Type: Monster (Common). This unusual creature is a small, brown-furred, rugged-looking canine with big jaws. It is not, however, a normal animal. It is intelligent, often travels in packs, and uses a limited teleportation ability. It can "blink out" of one spot and immediately appear ("blink in") at another.
